name: Daemonette

bonuses.name: Allure of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: Attack Tests made against Daemonettes use Willpower as their Attribute - ranged attacks use Ballistic Skill (Wil), melee attacks use Weapon Skill (Wil).

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Daemonette must pass a DN 3 Fear Test. The Daemonette then acts first in the Initiative order as though they had Seized the Initiative.

abilities.name: Exquisite Agonies
abilities.text: When this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical, its attacks gain the Agonising Trait.

note: Reprint of daemonette; differs in Tier row (A A E E T, Core A A E E), Resolve (3, Core 6), Piercing Claws trait (Rending (3), Core Penetrating (3)), and the Exquisite Agonies Wrath ability; no Alluress option printed.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
